patches.value: rules_version = '2'; service cloud.firestore { match /databases/{database}/documents { match /authoritySnapshots/{uid} { allow get: if request.auth != null && request.auth.uid == uid; allow list, create, update, delete: if false; } match /publicSnapshots/{uid} { allow get: if true; allow list, create, update, delete: if false; } match /commandLedger/{commandId} { allow read, write: if false; } match /extra/{id} { allow read: if true; } match /{document=**} { allow read, write: if false; } } }
